name: Venetian Duck Ragu
assumptions: Yield estimated from 4 duck legs + 600g pasta as main components for 4 adult servings
Total time sums active prep (~20 min) + 2hr covered simmer + 10-15 min uncovered simmer + pasta cook time (~10 min) + final 1 min, rounded to nearest 5 min
Milk present via 2 tbs dairy milk and Parmesan cheese
Wheat present via plain flour and durum wheat pasta
Parmesan classified as dairy (milk allergen) but not as vegetarian in some strict definitions; here diets use conservative ingredient compatibility
Chicken stock cube treated as non-vegetarian per recipe dietary note
No tree nuts, peanuts, fish, shellfish, eggs, soy, or sesame detected in listed ingredients
instructions:
Heat the oil in a large pan. Add the duck legs and brown on all sides for about 10 mins. Remove to a plate and set aside. Add the onions to the pan and cook for 5 mins until softened. Add the garlic and cook for a further 1 min, then stir in the cinnamon and flour and cook for a further min. Return the duck to the pan, add the wine, tomatoes, stock, herbs, sugar and seasoning. Bring to a simmer, then lower the heat, cover with a lid and cook for 2 hrs, stirring every now and then.
Carefully lift the duck legs out of the sauce and place on a plate – they will be very tender so try not to lose any of the meat. Pull off and discard the fat, then shred the meat with 2 forks and discard the bones. Add the meat back to the sauce with the milk and simmer, uncovered, for a further 10-15 mins while you cook the pasta.
Cook the pasta following pack instructions, then drain, reserving a cup of the pasta water, and add the pasta to the ragu. Stir to coat all the pasta in the sauce and cook for 1 min more, adding a splash of cooking liquid if it looks dry. Serve with grated Parmesan, if you like.

ingredients.assumptions: Medium onions ~110 g each; 2 onions = 220 g raw edible portion.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: Standard garlic cloves ~3 g each; 2 cloves = 6 g raw.

ingredients.name: Cinnamon
ingredients.assumptions: Ground cinnamon; typical small recipe amount of 2 tsp ≈ 5 g.

ingredients.name: Plain Flour
ingredients.assumptions: Plain white wheat flour; typical small recipe amount of 2 tsp ≈ 5 g.

ingredients.name: Chopped Tomatoes
ingredients.assumptions: Canned chopped tomatoes; 800 g can drained weight used as given (includes liquid).

ingredients.assumptions: 1 chicken stock cube dissolved; ~5 g cube contributes negligible macros when used as seasoning in large volume.

ingredients.name: Rosemary
ingredients.assumptions: 3 rosemary sprigs ≈ 5 g leaves; herbs contribute negligible calories/macros in this quantity.

ingredients.name: Bay Leaves
ingredients.assumptions: 2 bay leaves ≈ 1 g total; herbs contribute negligible calories/macros.

ingredients.name: Paccheri Pasta
ingredients.assumptions: Dry paccheri pasta (durum wheat); 600 g as given, uncooked weight.

ingredients.name: Parmesan Cheese
ingredients.assumptions: Grated Parmesan; 'grated to serve' estimated at typical 30 g total for the recipe (2 tbsp).
